prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental event piece about fireflies locking into phase. Around 102 BPM, G major. Scattered mallet pulses start random, then couple, then flash together. Twilight-joyful, not a drop-based dance track. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No four-on-the-floor kick pattern, no crowd noise.

[00:00–00:25] Isolated mallet notes, irregular, like separate insects.
[00:25–01:05] Pairs form; tiny clicks suggest nearby flashers.
[01:05–01:40] Large group locks; a soft tom marks the shared period.
[01:40–02:10] Unison flashes with warm strings, still gentle.
[02:10–02:30] Sync loosens slightly, remaining mostly together.
